points: 7.5% 'future-built' plus 41% scaling make up nearly half the market
AI spending rose from 1.7% to 3.3% of revenue in under a year
42% expect agents to hold decision authority by 2030
take: A year ago BCG put that at 5%. Leaders redesign whole workflows; only 5% of firms have full agent controls.
title: BCG: nearly half of companies now get real value from AI
